name: Dismiss Zombie
description: Backs a level-1 undead (e.g., Zombie) to a barrier and dismisses its spirit; caster must maintain the dismissal until it collapses.

name: Cure Wound
description: Cures 6 tblp to total body and touched location (or 2 Hits to monsters). Does not affect the undead.

name: Temporary Bless
description: Places a temporary blessing on a target for 1 hour.

name: Dismiss Skeleton
description: As Dismiss Zombie but for level-2 (or level-1) undead; forces it back and collapses it when cornered.

name: Befriend Spirit
description: Target treats the priest as a very trusted friend; retains free will. If betrayed, the spirit strikes back for level-based tblp.

name: Bless
description: Blesses a person or item (generally 24 hours; special permanent cases as noted for specific classes).

name: Cure Disease
description: Removes physical or spiritual diseases (not magically inflicted ones).

name: Control Skeleton
description: Controls one level-2 or level-1 undead as per Control Zombie with noted differences.

name: Protection from Spirits
description: Creates a chalk line that bars spirits of a chosen alignment (Good or Evil) from crossing/attacking through it within listed limits.

name: Spirit Shield
description: Absorbs the first 18 tblp of purely spiritual damage or undead touch effects (6 pts per touch) on the recipient.

name: Communication
description: Ask three yes/no questions of knowledgeable spirits within five minutes; silence if unknown.

name: Spirit Bolt
description: Ranged spiritual attack: 18 tblp to characters (applies SAC of least-protected location) or 6 Hits to monsters.

name: Control Ghoul
description: Controls one Ghoul (or other level-3 or lower undead) for the duration; can perform complex tasks.

name: Rune of Power
description: Inscribe and set a spiritual rune that triggers as described in its rules.

name: Halt Undead
description: Halts undead as per standard Halt; the phrase 'spirit of... I dismiss thee hence' counts as a blow for this miracle.

name: Repel Undead
description: Repels undead up to 21' as per the Paladinic effect.
sphere: Minor Dismissal / Minor Force / Minor Warding

name: Cure Insanity
description: Removes all insanities currently afflicting the target.

name: Warming Touch
description: Removes spiritual freeze effects from one target.
sphere: Minor Benediction / Minor Dismissal / Minor Healing

name: Remove Rune of Power
description: Negates an untriggered Rune of Power.

name: Spirit Dart
description: As Spirit Bolt but 6 tblp (or 2 Hits to monsters).

name: Milly’s Detect Spirits
description: Reveals location of all spirits within 20' of the caster.

name: Halt Undead
description: Neutral version of Halt that works as per the basic Halt; counts initial phrase as a blow.

name: Set Ward
description: Allows the caster to freely pass in/out of their own Ward of Power without collapse or harm.

name: Runed Ally
description: Marks a target to be immune to the caster’s own Warding-tree baneful effects for the adventure (releasable).

name: Enhance Rune of Power
description: Upgrades a just-placed Rune of Power to affect up to 11 levels of spiritual resistance.

name: Enhance Rune of Power
description: Universal version that upgrades a just-placed Rune of Power to affect up to 11 levels of spiritual resistance.

name: Minor Prayer
description: One Communication-style yes/no question (single question) within 30 seconds.

name: Enhance Stasis
description: As Stasis but affects targets up to caster level; 20-second duration; does not affect undead.

name: Force Touch
description: Short-duration force imbue (touch-based) as described in the entry.

name: Spirit Sundering
description: Double-effect Spirit Bolt for 36 tblp neutral spirit damage; normal Spirit Bolt resistances/SAC apply.

name: Overwhelming Force
description: Within 30s, touch a spirit to inflict Repel 20', Knockdown, and a non-level-based Halt.

name: Greater Spirit Shield
description: As Spirit Shield but absorbs 36 tblp; Minor Warding/Benediction sphere.

name: Bar Spirit
description: Bars a named (or indicated) spirit from crossing a Protection-style barrier for the duration.

name: Warding Rune of Defence
description: Self-inscribed defensive rune that retaliates on aggressors as described.

name: Dark Sundering
description: 36 tblp evil spirit damage (12 Hits to monsters). Spirit Bolt resistances and SAC apply; Causes resistances do not.

name: Command Undead
description: Controls undead up to level 9; spirit cost scales by undead level up to 14sp max; special exception for Animate-Life’d PCs.

name: Weakness
description: On touch within 30s, target loses 1 strength grade (cannot stack); immunity to strength-drain applies; does not affect undead.

name: Walk Through Walls
description: Caster moves through walls like a wraith for 5 minutes with noted casting/usage limits.

name: Touched by Evil
description: Protective undead-realm shroud around a target; details as per entry.

name: Wither
description: Touch causes a non-critical limb to become unusable; releasable; regeneration counters; does not affect undead.

name: Mass Paralysis
description: Paralyses all within 10' as per Paralysis; releasable (releases all at once); affects undead.

name: Mallerstang’s Cloak of the Inconsequential
description: Others ignore the caster as if not there until they attack or draw attention; domination/perception immunities apply; releasable.

name: Flood of Putrescence
description: Inflicts spiritual Disease on all in range (including caster); releasable releases all diseases simultaneously.

name: Lack of Faith
description: Target cannot cast sub-8th-level miracles for 60s; Resistances to Lack of Faith halve duration and restore casting by 1 level band.

name: Spiritual Candles
description: Creates four spiritual candles suitable for Restore Life (Good) or Animate Life (Evil).

name: Voice of Retribution
description: As Voice of Power but only the command “Die!”; affects up to caster level and only vs. the opposite alignment; does not affect undead.

name: Spirit Strike
description: Like Spirit Bolt but 36 tblp (12 Hits to monsters) AND a Halt (up to 8 levels); Halt doesn’t affect undead.

name: Rod of Righteousness
description: Creates a purely spiritual O-class rod of caster’s alignment (+1 vs. opposite-aligned spirits) usable only by the caster.

name: Create Skeletal Knight
description: As Animate Skeleton but tougher: not bound to point, blunt/spiritual only damage, +1 strength, DL 7, triple normal skeleton Hits.

name: Animate Life
description: Evil resurrection analogue that returns a target as ‘Animate Life’; has unique undead interactions and protection requirements.

name: Embody Wight Spirit
description: Caster mingles with a Wight’s spirit to gain its dark travel for the duration.

name: Halt
description: Freeze a lower-level target in place for ~10 seconds; broken by any touch/damage; does not affect undead.

name: Power Meld
description: Touch a willing lower-level priest to transfer all their remaining spirits to you (donor also loses 1 life per spirit); excess dissipates after 5 minutes.

name: Detect Spirit’s Nature
description: Discerns the alignment of a target spirit (Good/Neutral/Evil); no response if no spirit.

name: Spirit of Seeing
description: Send a spirit to look and report; short, immediate informational glimpse in a pointed direction.

name: Cure Serious Wounds
description: Cure 12 tblp (or 4 Hits to a monster) distributed across locations as desired; not effective on undead.

name: Control Zombie
description: Take control of a zombie’s spirit (or other level-1 undead by name) for 30 minutes, overcoming equal/lower controller level.

name: Talk to Spirit
description: Ask three yes/no (one-word) questions of a spirit within range; powerful living/intelligent undead may lie, lesser cannot.

name: Control Skeleton
description: Control one level-2 (or level-1) undead for 30 minutes as per Control Zombie.

name: Protection from Spirits
description: Chalk line barrier that bars either Good or Evil spirits (chosen when cast); level-based; blocks attacks through the line.

name: Spirit Shield
description: Absorbs first 18 tblp of purely spiritual damage or undead touch effects (6 shield points per touch) on the recipient.

name: Bless
description: Bless a person or item for 24h (+2 DAC to people; special object rules); interacts with Curses per class rules.

name: Befriend Spirit
description: Target treats you as a very trusted friend (not controlled). If your actions directly cause their death, you suffer level-scaled tblp backlash.

name: Cure Disease
description: Remove physical or spiritual diseases (not magically inflicted ones); works on items; does not affect undead.

name: Dismiss Ghoul
description: Dismiss one level-3 undead (e.g., Ghoul) by forcing it back to a barrier and completing the dismissal phrase at ~9’ distance.

name: Communication
description: Ask three yes/no questions of knowledgeable spirits within five minutes; silence if unknown.

name: Spirit Bolt
description: Ranged spiritual attack: 18 tblp to characters (SAC of least-protected location applies) or 6 Hits to monsters.

name: Control Ghoul
description: Control one ghoul or other level-3 or lower undead; can perform complex tasks; duration as per control rules.

name: Rune of Power
description: Inscribe a rune (Fear/Paralysis/Insanity; Disturbance or Transgression) that triggers and persists per entry until released by Bless/beneficial Curse.

name: Dismiss Mummy
description: Dismiss one level-4 undead (e.g., Mummy) by forcing it back; it can still attack others who come too close during dismissal.

name: Heal
description: Cure up to 36 tblp (or 12 Hits to a monster), distributed across locations; does not affect undead.

name: Minor Ward of Power
description: Draw a four-cornered ward that bars low-level undead and creatures ≤4th level; inflicts spiritual damage on crossing; absorbs 10sp of directed miracles.

name: Remove Voice of Power
description: Cancel one Voice of Power currently affecting a target; also removes Halt/Stasis-type effects.

name: Voice of Power
description: Command a single-word imperative a lower-level target must obey (e.g., Sleep/Flee/Obey); listed stopping effect; does not affect undead.

name: Dismiss Wraith
description: Dismiss one level-5 undead (e.g., Wraith); when dismissal begins it cannot walk through walls; complete at ~9’ with the release phrase.

name: Remove Fear and Paralysis
description: Touch to end fear and paralysis effects currently afflicting the target; standard limitations per entry.

name: Control Wraith
description: Control one level-5 (or lower) undead; if cast immediately after you summon it, control lasts 30 minutes, otherwise 5 minutes.

name: Greater Communication
description: As Communication but answers are short phrases/sentences (≈7 relevant words); three questions in five minutes.

name: Major Ward of Power
description: As Minor Ward but stronger: bars all undead; bars creatures with resistance levels up to 7th; deals heavy spiritual damage on crossing; absorbs 20sp of directed miracles.

name: Cause Minor Wound
description: Touch to inflict minor spiritual injury to a living target.

name: Cause Wound
description: Stronger touch-based spiritual injury to a living target.

name: Cause Serious Wounds
description: Touch to inflict serious spiritual injury to a living target.

name: Curse
description: Either impose −2 DAC for 24h or grant +2 DAC for 1h to an evil target behaving evilly; can also curse objects; special dying-curse rules apply.

name: Animate Skeleton
description: Raise one skeleton from a suitable corpse; gains hits based on your level; half damage from sharp; weak inherent control for 30 minutes.

name: Cause Disease
description: Inflict a spiritual or physical disease on a living target, per ref notes; object-cursing interactions as noted.

name: Cause Fear
description: Instil fear in a living target, per listed stopping/level rules.

name: Beguile Spirit
description: Charm-like sway over a living target’s spirit (not full control), as per entry’s limits.

name: Create Ghoul
description: Create a ghoul from a suitable corpse with stats per system; under your control per create/control rules.

name: Create Mummy
description: Create a mummy from a suitable corpse with stats per system; under your control per create/control rules.

name: Cause Grievous Wounds
description: Impose grievous, location-spreading spiritual damage on a living target as described in the entry.

name: Dismiss Skeleton
description: Dismiss a level-2 undead (or other level-1–2 by name) by forcing it back to a barrier and releasing it at ~9’.

name: Dismiss Ghoul
description: Dismiss a level-3 undead (e.g., Ghoul) as above; complete with the release phrase at ~9’.

name: Dismiss Mummy
description: Dismiss a level-4 undead (e.g., Mummy); it may still attack others who come too close while being driven back.

name: Dismiss Wraith
description: Dismiss a level-5 undead (e.g., Wraith); once dismissal starts it cannot walk through walls.

name: Dismiss Vampire
description: Dismiss a level-6 undead (e.g., Vampire) by forcing it back to a barrier and completing the release phrase at the end.
